{{Item description|Designed by Hongshan Swordmancers and assembled by the AIC. This equipment can improve the wearer's combat capabilities.|Legacy of a "mad" Tianshi. 
The Tianshi responsible for pushing the legacy design to the production floor also realized it was too barebones. Hence, they designed additional protective slabs to supplement the defenses.}}
